reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No direct PD/PK data provided, but established doses for all three agents suggest adequate target engagement. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Strong clinical efficacy with 86% progression-free survival at 6 months (95% CI: 75-93%) in HER2+ metastatic breast cancer, which is clinically meaningful. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analysis reported, but enrolled appropriate HER2+ population. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Single-arm design limits interpretation, but effect size is robust and consistent with known efficacy of dual HER2 blockade.
